# Japan Cheapo

> > Japan Cheapo is your budget travel guide to exploring Japan affordably, covering major destinations like Osaka, Kyoto, Kanazawa, and beyond.

Japan Cheapo provides comprehensive budget travel guides, discount passes, itineraries, and local insights for exploring Japan's cities, festivals, food scenes, and cultural attractions without breaking the bank. The site specializes in practical money-saving tips for transportation, accommodations, dining, and sightseeing across regions from Hokkaido to Shikoku.

## Key Topics

- Budget travel in Japan
- Osaka food and attractions
- Kyoto temples and cultural sites
- Kanazawa sightseeing
- Day trips and itineraries
- Discount passes and transportation
- Hanami (cherry blossom viewing)
- Japanese festivals and events
- Nara attractions
- Food tours and local cuisine
- Universal Studios Japan
- Shinkansen bullet train savings
- Winter illuminations
- Hokuriku region travel

## Travel Guides & Itineraries

- [How To Spend a Week in Beautiful Hokuriku](https://japancheapo.com/travel/hokuriku-itinerary): Week-long Hokuriku itinerary covering Fukui, Toyama & Ishikawa
- [4 Day Trips from Kyoto](https://japancheapo.com/travel/day-trip-kyoto): Budget day trips from Kyoto including Nara Park & UNESCO sites
- [7 Easy Day Trips From Kanazawa: Hot Springs and History](https://japancheapo.com/travel/day-trips-from-kanazawa): Day trips from Kanazawa featuring Yuwaku Onsen & cultural sites
- [Mount Kōya: A Visitor's Guide to Japan's Most Sacred Site](https://japancheapo.com/entertainment/mount-koya-day-trip): Visitor guide to Mount Koya Shingon Buddhism pilgrimage site
